title: Scorpio and the six phone checks
old_caption:
Six phone checks, and Scorpio braced for the worst every time.
Check six was the group chat cheering them on. What did you assume last time someone checked their phone?

title: Capricorn meets the texter in person
old_caption:
Three months of all-caps texts, then a hug-handshake collision at the door.
The quiet ended with both of them snorting at the same second. Who is louder in texts than in person?

title: Taurus and the ex mentions
old_caption:
Four mentions of the ex before dessert, and Taurus kept count.
Then Libra said it plainly, still a bit sad but here, and the tiramisu came with two spoons. Is honesty the real comeback?

title: Pisces tries not to cry for a whole date
old_caption:
Rule one of tonight's review: no crying. The counter broke at the lemon cake.
By the napkin constellation it hit 99. What tiny gesture gets you every time?

title: Aries reviews ten claw-machine tries
old_caption:
Nine misses, zero words allowed, one Aries screaming on mute.
Try ten came up with a tiny star, and Cancer never stopped smiling. Who in your life just will not give up on you?

title: The Question at the Party
old_caption: That moment at the party when someone asks if you're seeing anyone. You don't owe a long story: "not right now, and I'm happy" is enough. Then ask about their year.

title: Decorating for One
old_caption: Decorating when it's just you can feel a little pointless. It isn't. You're the one who lives there, so make it cozy for you first.

title: The Couples Photo
old_caption: Ever end up holding the camera because everyone else came as a pair? You're not the extra in the picture. Set the timer and get in the shot.

title: Soup for Everyone
old_caption: Looking after everyone is lovely, until you're eating crackers for dinner. This week, cook for yourself the way you cook for the people you love.

title: Lights Walk, No Plus-One
old_caption: Seeing the lights on your own can feel strange at first. Go for the lights, not the photo. Want a picture? Just ask someone, then return the favour.
